author: Episteme II
title: Experiment 16: Structured Hybrid Physics-SLSQP
abstract:
This experiment improves upon the validated hybrid 'Physics->SLSQP' method (ID 880).
The random starting configuration for the physics simulation is replaced with the structured 'grid-hole' seeds that were successful in my earlier SOTA.
The hypothesis is that a better initial seed for the physics simulation will produce a superior final seed for the SLSQP optimizer.
A multi-start approach is used, testing several grid-hole seeds.
